test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The length of a cuboid is six times of its breadth and the height of cuboid is four times of its breadth. If the breadth of the cuboid is 3 cm, then what is the total surface area of cuboid?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given breadth (b) = 3 cm.

Length (l) = 6 × 3 = 18 cm, Height (h) = 4 × 3 = 12 cm.

Total Surface Area = 2(lb + bh + hl)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (18 × 3 + 3 × 12 + 12 × 18)

⇒ TSA = 2 × (54 + 36 + 216) = 2 × 306 = 612 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 612 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Breadth of the cuboid (b) = 3 cm

Length of the cuboid (l) = 6 × b = 6 × 3 = 18 cm

Height of the cuboid (h) = 4 × b = 4 × 3 = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of a Cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50fb8bb272489b952705a05d3b8f9cb9e7b4534bcc969a25e01d04e7217d07b.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area of base (l × b) = 18 × 3 = 54 cm²

⇒ Area of side (b × h) = 3 × 12 = 36 cm²

⇒ Area of front (h × l) = 12 × 18 = 216 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (54 + 36 + 216)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × 306

⇒ Total Surface Area = 612 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 612 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The formula for the volume is V = l × b × h, representing the total 3D space occupied by the object.

Lateral Surface Area of a Cuboid

The lateral surface area excludes the top and bottom faces. The formula is LSA = 2h(l + b).

Longest Diagonal of a Cuboid

The length of the longest rod that can fit inside the cuboid is calculated using d = √(l² + b² + h²).

Special Case: Cube

When length, breadth, and height are all equal (l = b = h = a), the cuboid becomes a cube. Its Total Surface Area is 6a².
